notes: A window you resize now stays resized: the size is saved with the rest of the config, and opening a module's gear menu no longer snaps the panel back to 580x430. Load config now rebuilds the pages that are drawn from it (saved Tesla spots). Cursor magnetism puts a leaning control back when you switch it off mid-hover. Section headings carry a hairline, the window edge is a gradient rim, and the cold-gas keybind shows up in the keybind overlay.
